meta.instagramCaption:
CBI ya Police kabhi bhi WhatsApp par 'Digital Arrest' nahi karti! 🚨🛑

Bharat me 1200+ crore rupaye is scam me loote ja chuke hain. Remember these 3 rules:
1. No Digital Arrest in Indian Law
2. Never transfer funds to 'verification accounts'
3. Immediate Emergency Helpline: Dial 1930

Apne parents aur family group me share karein!

#CyberSecurity #DigitalArrest #ScamAlert #India #TechWithGenZ #CyberCrime1930
